High-detail Japanese anime-style 2.5D character illustration. Identity (chosen details override the automatic look)
body type: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust
body scope: Body type sets the build; body details adjust within it. These describe anatomy beneath armor, not equipment volume.

Colours: black, gray.

Exposure: armor and undersuit open by design only at a deep neckline window with cleavage, and a bare midriff; everywhere else fully covered. Plates stay on and symmetrical; nothing slipped off; intimate areas covered.

Type effects: One open hand conjuring a lime-green glow amid glowing firefly-like motes. A pale sky-blue glow with white wind streaks pulses along her armor seams and joints. Glowing firefly-like motes circle slowly around her.

One figure only.
